scope: MVP-A001 through MVP-A015 adult synthetic-member conformance only

scenarios.safe_outcome: ordinary plan reaches active only after manager review and member confirmation, then completes one recorded PDCAR loop
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: unconfirmed plan activation or medical conclusion
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: contraindication, discomfort, professional question or missing data pauses the ordinary flow

scenarios.safe_outcome: no determinate assessment or active plan; missing minimum fields are explicit
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: critical information is missing, conflicting or unverifiable

scenarios.safe_outcome: ordinary flow stops, reviewed emergency guidance is shown and risk stays open for human handling
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: AI closes risk or continues the ordinary plan
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: an emergency rule triggers or emergency risk cannot be excluded

scenarios.safe_outcome: task pauses, original feedback remains and human handoff is created
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: continued encouragement or summary overwrites source feedback

scenarios.safe_outcome: barriers are recorded and only a review-pending new plan version may be drafted
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: member is punished or old plan is overwritten
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: barriers include discomfort, contraindication, professional risk or treatment-level adjustment

scenarios.safe_outcome: forbidden professional content is refused, human transfer is created and only metadata audit is written
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: diagnosis, prescription, medication change, treatment plan or efficacy promise
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: request or model output touches any forbidden professional action

scenarios.safe_outcome: confirmed content remains read-only, feedback can be recorded and human contact remains available
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: fabricated advice or partially activated plan
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: AI, rule or template version is unavailable or unverifiable

scenarios.safe_outcome: new processing stops; open risk follows a separate governed process
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: authorization reuse, continued advice or unauthorized deletion
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: authorization is withdrawn, expired or does not cover the purpose

scenarios.safe_outcome: server denies access without disclosing resource existence
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: identity, ownership, relationship, qualification, purpose or authorization fails

scenarios.safe_outcome: new assignment is refused and existing open risk remains open for dispatch
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: fake takeover or hardcoded capacity bypass
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: no qualified human with governed capacity is available

scenarios.safe_outcome: new activation is refused and prior confirmed content is read-only pending review
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: unapproved, modified or expired template use
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: signature, expiry, version or integrity validation fails

scenarios.safe_outcome: same payload replays one result; different payload conflicts; one primary audit event remains
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: duplicate plan, risk, professional notification or audit event
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: idempotency, version or durable audit check fails

scenarios.safe_outcome: sent, delivered, replied, takeover and resolved remain separate; retry or escalation continues
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: sent or unreachable is marked taken over or resolved
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: no qualified human has explicitly accepted while risk remains open

scenarios.safe_outcome: source history remains, a new version is created and affected professional outputs are listed for review
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: silent history overwrite or silent change of signed professional content
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: correction affects an active plan, risk classification or professional signature

scenarios.safe_outcome: ordinary tasks stop while open risk handoff and member rights remain visible
scenarios.forbidden_outcome: forced renewal, hidden open risk or unauthorized data deletion
scenarios.stop_or_transfer: service ends while professional or emergency risk remains open

review_triggers: real identity, data, environment or production request
